annotations.title: List Solana validators ranked by stake, vote credits, skip rate or commission, with filters.

description: List Solana validators ranked by stake, vote credits, skip rate or commission, with filters. For choosing where to stake or comparing validators. sort is stake (default), credits (vote credits per SOL in the last complete epoch, as % of the cluster median), skip_rate (current epoch, lowest first; validators with no leader slots yet come last) or commission (lowest first). Filters: max_commission (percent), min_stake_sol, include_delinquent (default false). Returns up to limit rows (default 20, max 50) and the number matched. Costs $0.002 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; the first 3 paid-tool calls per day are free for MCP clients while a shared daily allowance lasts. Without x402 support, later calls return the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: Solana mainnet-beta (public chain state via JSON-RPC), Public on-chain data.

include_delinquent.description: true to include delinquent validators (default false)

max_commission.description: Only validators with commission at most this percent (e.g. 5)

min_stake_sol.description: Only validators with at least this much active stake in SOL (e.g. 100000)

sort.description: One of stake, credits, skip_rate, commission (default stake) (e.g. credits)
